severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — SYNTHETIC FOOTAGE ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: FAKE-SURVEILLANCE FRONT ROLLS THROUGH THE YOUTUBE SHORTS GORGE AS GENERATED SECURITY-CAM CLIPS DEPICT IMPOSSIBLE EVENTS TIMESTAMPED TO 03:47 IN A HALLWAY THAT NEVER EXISTED
advisory: A dense band of machine-generated 'surveillance footage' is moving across the lower Gorge, characterized by grainy overlays, a fictional timestamp counting up in the corner, and a caption reading 'CAUGHT ON CAMERA.' Residents are advised that no camera was present, no hallway was built, and no event occurred. The Service reminds the public that authentic footage rarely arrives pre-loaded with a swelling orchestral sting.

regional_outlook.conditions: Peak activity. Vertical clips of body-horror 'security cam' anomalies accumulating at a rate of one every autoplay, with the loop restarting before any resident can confirm what they just saw.
Reposts of the same synthetic footage stripped of context and captioned 'this is terrifying.' Winds of quote-tweeted alarm gusting to viral before nightfall.
Older reruns of the front settling in shared-group backwaters, where the timestamp reads a year that has not yet arrived and no one has flagged it.
Scattered 'is this real' queries pooling in the low ground, returning three explainer pages that were themselves generated overnight.
Mostly clear, with an isolated forward from a relative captioned 'you have to see this.' You do not.

specimen.habitat: Autoplay chains in the Shorts Gorge; late-night repost eddies in the Badlands.
specimen.field_marks: Low-resolution 'CCTV' grain applied uniformly to a suspiciously cinematic composition. A running timestamp that ticks with impossible smoothness. Shadows that fall in two directions at once and a doorway that changes width between frames.
specimen.call: CAUGHT ON CAMERA AT 3:47 AM — WAIT FOR IT... YOU WON'T BELIEVE WHAT HAPPENS NEXT
specimen.confusion_species: Genuine home-security footage, which is boring, correctly lit, and features a raccoon rather than a hallway that reconfigures itself. If the clip escalates into a payoff, it was written, not recorded.

spotter_tip: Watch the corners. A real timestamp stutters and skips; a generated one glides like it has somewhere to be. When the ceiling and the floor disagree about where the light is coming from, you are not looking at a camera — you are looking at a render.
tomorrow: The synthetic-footage front lingers overnight before a warm patch of 'AI historical reenactment' clips drifts in from the west, in which everyone in 1850 has perfect teeth.

confirmed_sighting.report: Field coverage of the video-slop wave reports that nearly 10 of YouTube's 100 fastest-growing channels in 2025 were AI-generated — including grotesque 'cat soap opera' clips — prompting YouTube to demonetize or remove some channels, while researchers measured a 40% drop in engagement with AI-generated articles.
